case: Separate model response latency, application bootstrap work and JVM execution configuration
evidence_mode: Runtime-owner HTTP observation plus existing single-pass offline JFR analysis; not a new source-generation model trial.
approval: Root explicitly requested this sanitized portable summary; no raw recording, complete argv, private paths or machine/game identities are approved.

runtime_model_layer.scope: An earlier ordinary-planning request, a different phase from the bootstrap recording. Do not subtract3.252from45.0803 or treat these as paired A/B measurements. Transport response timing is not end-to-end business latency.

JVM_configuration_evidence.source: The one closed recording actualjdk.JVMInformation event, not an outer launch template.
limits: Startup argument evidence does not measure the compilation tier of every method or prove the causal share of C1.
Startupagent arguments are not a complete dynamic-attach agent inventory.
A future allow-C2 experiment may change warmup/compilation costs; no improvement has yet been verified.

recording.phase: Entirely bootstrap before the later loop; no Action/SAVE coverage.

observed_samples.limits: Execution and native samples stay separate. Inclusive stacks overlap. These counts are not exact calls, CPU percentages, elapsed seconds or a proof that the full bootstrap is one leaf.

limits: Do not add root pauses to GC/young/old cycle durations or nested pause events; these overlap and concurrent cycle time need not be a pause.
Recorded root pauses alone do not account for the45second window.
No thresholded FileRead event does not mean no IO. Native JNA ReadFile is not guaranteed to emit the JDK FileRead instrumentation event.
Observed cross-thread/type durations can overlap and the cached aggregates are not clipped to the header.

allocation_boundary.interpretation: One extreme weight dominates. These are recorded statistical weights, not858GBactually allocated, live heap or measured allocation throughput.
allocation_boundary.exact_ThreadAllocationStatistics_delta: Not captured by the existing utility; event count/schema cannot recover the values. No second pass was added to conceal this gap.

operator_cost.limits: Initial source/navigation reads preceded the marker. Preparation, owner review, coordination and summary wall are separate from the parser process time; this is not a full game performance window.
operator_cost.preparation_correction: Inherited runner used exact path-string formatting; equivalent path representations were normalized before any grant or JVM. No executed analysis failure or consumed event pass.

reusable_tool_boundary.status: Existing unchanged finite offline reference utility, not a newly verified general platform.
known_limits: Legacy fixed historical window labels must be excluded for other recordings.
Only the captured JVMInformation fields/50configrows are available; dedicated agent values and precise per-thread allocation deltas are absent.
Use an explicit small closed-file scope with external time/memory bounds; top-list limits do not prove unbounded-input memory safety.
